mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have a beautiful day at 81 degrees with clear skies over the Verona Public Library. It is a First Quarter Moon tonight, and if you are looking for a cosmic show, the International Space Station will be visible at 9:33 PM, rising over Middleton near Verona High School and moving toward Fitchburg halfway up the sky.

For city updates, the VHAT cable channel serves as our public access hub for government meetings and community news. Also, please remember that the city has specific ordinances regarding vehicle parking; residential areas generally allow four vehicles per single-family home, and storage in front yards is prohibited.

This week in Verona is packed with events. We have trivia nights starting Tuesday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday at Hometown Junction Park. Plus, don't miss the Concerts in the Park series continuing this Thursday.

In our police report for the week, on July 14, officers stopped a vehicle for driving without headlights, which led to the discovery of marijuana, drug paraphernalia, and a firearm, resulting in multiple citations.

You can enjoy the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist today at Culver's. They are open until 10 PM tonight, which gives you plenty of time to stop by. Tomorrow, the flavor of the day will be Mint Explosion.
